#

2\. Domain Invariants

| Class        | Invariant / rule                                                       | How protected                                                                                                                   |
| ------------ | ---------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Patient      | patientID must be unique and never change once assigned                | Attribute kept private                                                                                                          |
| Practitioner | schedule must always reflect actual bookings                           | schedule kept private; only readable via getScheduledAppointments() and checkAvailability()                                     |
| Appointment  | status can only change through cancel() or updateStatus()              | status kept private; those two methods are the only way to alter it, and they check the current status before applying a change |
| Receptionist | Receptionist must act through Patient/Appointment's own public methods | Enforced by design: Receptionist's methods (bookAppointment(), cancel()                                                         |

# 3\. Composition / Inheritance Decisions

| Relationship                         | Decision                                       | Rationale                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| ------------------------------------ | ---------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Patient — Appointment                | Composition/Association                        | Appointment holds a reference to a Patient; they are separate, independently existing objects, not an "is-a" relationship                                                                           |
| Practitioner — Appointment           | Composition/Association                        | Same reasoning, Appointment references a Practitioner rather than being a type of one                                                                                                               |
| Receptionist — Appointment           | Association (manages)                          | Receptionist initiates operations on Appointment but does not own or store its data                                                                                                                 |
| Appointment — PatientRecord          | Inheritance rejected; composition used instead | The AI-generated code incorrectly made Appointment inherit from PatientRecord; corrected to a simple reference (self.patient), since an Appointment is not a type of patient record                 |
| Doctor — Practitioner (hypothetical) | Inheritance                                    | A Doctor would be a specialised type of Practitioner (same "is-a" test), inheriting Practitioner's attributes/behaviours and potentially adding its own. Not yet in the scope for the current model |

# 4\. AI Pair-Programming Record

| AI contribution                                              | Conforms? | Decision | Reason                                                                                                                    | Verification                                                                        |
| ------------------------------------------------------------ | --------- | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Public status attribute, directly settable from outside      | No        | Rejected | Violates the status invariant (Section 2) — status must only change via cancel()/updateStatus()                           | Checked against Domain Invariants table, confirmed violation                        |
| SQL query embedded directly inside cancel()                  | No        | Rejected | Mixes logic into a domain class, Appointment should only manage its own state, not talk to a database                     | Checked against separation-of-concerns principle from Activity 4 – AI Code Critique |
| Direct dependency on NotificationManager inside Appointment  | No        | Rejected | SMS/email reminders are still Pending Review (Section 4 of AI Design Review Record, v0.3)                                 | Cross-checked against AI Design Review Record status                                |
| Appointment(PatientRecord) inheriting from PatientRecord     | No        | Rejected | Fails the "is-a" test (Section 3), an Appointment is not a type of patient record, should reference a Patient instead     | Checked against Composition/Inheritance Decisions table                             |
| No validation of status transitions before applying a change | No        | Rejected | Combined effect of the above two flaws leaves no enforcement point for the status invariant, allowing illegal transitions | Checked against Domain Invariants table                                             |
